# AI Dictionary Review Admin Dashboard

## Page Overview
This is an administrative control panel for managing AI-generated dictionary entries through a morphological analysis system. It serves as a quality assurance interface where terms created automatically by AI undergo human review before deployment.

## Main Navigation Structure
- **Primary Sections**: 검색엔진 관리 (Search Engine Management) and 형태소 분석 (Morphological Analysis)
- **Dictionary Management Menu**:
  - 시스템 사전 (System Dictionary)
  - 사용자 사전 (User Dictionary)
  - 동의어 사전 (Synonym Dictionary)
  - 단위명 사전 (Unit Name Dictionary)
  - 복합명사 사전 (Compound Noun Dictionary)
  - AI 사전 (AI Dictionary)
  - 형태소 분석기 (Morphological Analyzer)

## Main Content Section: "AI 사전 관리"

**Review Mode Purpose**: "AI에 의해 자동 생성된 단어를 검토합니다. 승인된 단어는 사용자 사전으로 이동됩니다." (Review words auto-generated by AI; approved terms move to user dictionary)

### Filtering & Actions
- Status filters: 전체, 대기중 (Pending), 거부됨 (Rejected)
- POS filters: 명사 (NNG), 고유명사 (NNP)
- Batch operations for bulk approval/rejection

### Data Table (Review Batch #202410-01)
Displays 48 pending words with columns for term, POS tag, AI confidence score, status, extraction timestamp, and management actions.

**Sample entries shown**:
- "생성형AI" (generative AI) - 94.2% confidence
- "프롬프트" (prompt) - 88.5% confidence
- "할루시네이션" (hallucination) - 76.4% confidence
